name: codex-skilled
description: Capture privacy-aware Skill observations locally and turn approved observations into candidate skilled regression cases.

interface.shortDescription: Review Skill usage and create regression cases.
interface.longDescription: Observes explicitly attributed Skill interactions through Codex lifecycle hooks, redacts common credentials before local persistence, and requires human approval before writing a candidate evaluation case.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use skilled-improve to review my local Skill observations and propose an approved regression case.
